answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 5686 Country: India Title: Wanted to know that I'm having patnership in one of the hotel/guest house where they have television in each room. So the income which I get from that hotel is it legal or "Na-Jayez/Haraam". Question: Wanted to know that I'm having patnership in one of the hotel/guest house where they have television in each room. So the income which I get from that hotel is it legal or "Na-Jayez/Haraam". Answer ID: 5686 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 790/724=D) The income of the hotel shall not be regarded as unlawful and haram , it is allowed to have partnership. However, you should keep on objecting to having television in the rooms. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
